claims.statement: FedRAMP is established in statute by the FedRAMP Authorization Act (FY2023 NDAA), codified at 44 U.S.C. §§ 3607-3616, as the government-wide approach to security assessment and authorisation of cloud services used by federal agencies; OMB Memorandum M-24-15 (July 2024) sets current policy, and FedRAMP 20x adds an automation-based path.
claims.notes: 2026 changes (renaming to "FedRAMP Certification", classes A-D, Consolidated Rules 2026) reported by secondary sources; not modelled. claims.statement: NDAA FY2019 Section 889 (FAR 52.204-25) prohibits US federal agencies from procuring, or contracting with entities that use, certain covered telecommunications and video surveillance equipment; it is a candidate basis for SOV.HW.PROVENANCE.
